episodes.164059: An upper low near the Big Island and a weak, west-moving surface trough induced heavy showers over portions of the Aloha State.  The rain caused ponding on roadways, and small stream and drainage ditch flooding on Maui, Kauai, and the Big Island.  No serious property damage or injuries were reported.
episodes.164550: A cold frontal passage from a clipper system moving through the Upper Great Lakes generated storm force west wind gusts over eastern Lake Superior early on the 2nd.
